name: 3D Gallery & Carousel Block – GENE Motion Blocks
author: onecraftne

sections.description:
GENE Motion Blocks adds a 3D Ring gallery block to the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg). Arrange your images on a rotating 3D ring — a real 3D image gallery / carousel — with depth-aware lighting and an optional floor reflection. It is CSS-native first, ships its own tiny JavaScript, loads nothing from third-party CDNs, and falls back gracefully — so it never breaks your pages and never hijacks the scrollbar.

Looking for a 3D gallery block, a 3D carousel, a rotating image gallery, or a coverflow-style slider for the block editor? The 3D Ring gives you all of that in one native Gutenberg block — no page builder and no external libraries required.

Add it from the block inserter under the GENE Motion category:

  • 3D Ring — a rotating 3D gallery of your images with depth-aware lighting and an optional floor reflection. It can auto-rotate, tilt toward the cursor, and be spun by dragging, scrolling or the arrow keys. Built on CSS 3D transforms, which Safari, Firefox and Chromium all support.

Never-break by design. The block degrades to a plain, responsive image gallery when 3D transforms aren’t supported, when motion is reduced (prefers-reduced-motion), or when JavaScript is off. Your images are always visible.

No libraries, no lock-in. No jQuery, no GSAP, no slider library, nothing loaded from someone else’s CDN. The block’s front-end script only loads on pages that actually use it, so it stays fast. Deactivate the plugin and your content stays as native markup.

Great for: photo galleries, product showcases, portfolios, team or logo carousels, and any place you want a 3D image gallery that looks premium without a heavy slider plugin.

Motion Blocks Pro

The free plugin ships the 3D Ring gallery. GENE Motion Blocks Pro adds a suite of scroll & motion blocks — Snap Sections (with Cover / Split / Quote / Stats / CTA presets), a Horizontal Scroll Gallery, a Fan Gallery, a Scroll Spin Gallery and an Orbit Gallery — plus the full per-block design controls and priority support. Pro is a separate product — learn more at https://gene-wp.com/.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit a page or post, open the block inserter, and look for the GENE Motion category.
  3. Add the 3D Ring block, choose your images, and publish.
sections.faq:
Is this a 3D gallery or a carousel?

Both — the 3D Ring arranges your images on a rotating ring in real 3D, so it works as a 3D image gallery, a 3D carousel, or a coverflow-style slider, depending on how you use it.

Does the 3D Ring slow down my site?

No. There are no external libraries and no CDN requests. The block’s front-end script is only loaded on pages that contain the block.

Does it need jQuery, GSAP or a slider library?

No. The 3D motion is built with native CSS 3D transforms plus a tiny bundled script. Nothing loads from a third-party CDN.

What happens on older browsers or with reduced motion?

The block falls back to a plain, responsive image gallery. Your images are always visible; the 3D motion is a progressive enhancement.

Will my content break if I deactivate the plugin?

The saved content is native block markup, so your images remain in place. The 3D styling is provided by the plugin, so the motion stops, but the layout and content stay intact.
sections.changelog:
3.4.1

  • Clearer listing: the plugin is now described as a 3D gallery / carousel block so it’s easier to find. No functional changes.

3.4.0

  • New direction: this plugin is now GENE Motion Blocks, built around the 3D Ring gallery block — a CSS-native 3D gallery / carousel for the block editor.
  • The previous “Complete Site” generator has been retired. Pages you already generated are native core blocks and keep working — but the generator screen is gone.
  • The scroll & motion blocks (Snap Sections, Horizontal Scroll Gallery, Fan Gallery, Scroll Spin Gallery, Orbit Gallery) are available in GENE Motion Blocks Pro.
